services.desc: Guests also enjoy access to hot showers, clean restrooms, a modern laundry facility, and a dog park. Located near downtown Elizabethtown, Fort Knox, Mammoth Cave, Bardstown, local sports venues, and the BlueOval Battery Park area, E-Town RV Park is an ideal home base for work, extended stays, or exploring central Kentucky. Pull in, back in, and get comfortable fast. These sites are set up for smooth arrivals, with full hookups and dependable 30 and 50 amp power, plus a roomy concrete pad and side pad for your vehicle.
